statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ has extended its rebound to near the session high, but softer oil, Treasury yields and VIX reduce cross-asset confirmation ahead of CPI.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold because current extension is not yet supported by broad one-way cross-asset confirmation, while CPI and the cash-open sequence remain the main path checkpoints.
headline: NQ reaches near session high before CPI as cross-asset pressure eases
body: Delayed NQ data showed 29,300.75, up 0.57%, with a 29,120.75-29,318.00 session range. Brent had eased toward $104.55, the U.S. 10-year yield toward 4.94%, and VIX toward 17.4. The rebound is strong, but the current evidence does not yet establish a pathological no-retracement path.

lookbackSummary: Tail reached elevated levels during the September 10 U.S. event and cash-open window, then returned to WATCH as persistent one-way structure did not hold. Overnight on September 11, Tail stayed in WATCH while Stress remained extreme.
outlookSummary: NQ has extended its rebound to near the session high, but easing oil, yields and VIX keep cross-asset confirmation incomplete. CPI at 12:30 UTC and the cash-open/Michigan sequence are the main conditional danger window; Tail escalation requires observed persistence after those checkpoints.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ data show 29,300.75, up 0.57% and only 17.25 points below the 29,318 session high after rebounding from 29,120.75. The fresh extension raises Tail to the top of WATCH, while softer oil, yields and VIX temper cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: Pre-CPI liquidity can become thinner and more directional. Tail remains WATCH unless NQ holds an extreme through shallow counter-moves; two-sided trade would keep the path below the blocking threshold despite very high Stress.

August CPI is scheduled for 12:30 UTC in this hour. The result and reaction are unobserved at the cutoff; Tail stays WATCH beforehand, with the first post-release retracement and any repeated extension serving as the key conditional path test.

After CPI and into the 13:30 UTC cash open, Tail is conditionally elevated only if NQ repeatedly extends, holds an extreme, or rejects a meaningful retracement. Orderly two-sided discovery would invalidate the elevated path.

The first full cash hour also contains preliminary Michigan sentiment at 14:00 UTC. Elevated Tail is conditional on opening continuation or a second directional leg; a sustained retracement would argue for rapid de-escalation.

By the second cash hour, persistence should be clearer. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks would sustain elevated Tail; successful retracement, lower realized volatility and cross-asset stabilization would favor de-escalation.

If the first two cash hours establish two-sided trade, Tail is expected to return to WATCH. A renewed move to session extremes without meaningful retracement would be the condition that keeps risk above this path.

Mid-session conditions should become less event-driven if CPI repricing is absorbed. Tail remains WATCH under a two-sided path; a fresh catalyst aligned with renewed one-way NQ extension would challenge that assumption.

Later cash-session risk is expected to ease if realized volatility contracts. Tail would rise only if price resumes directional efficiency with shallow pullbacks or if geopolitical or rates stress creates another aligned impulse.

Approaching the final two cash hours, two-sided price discovery would support WATCH. A late-session trend that holds an extreme through failed retracements would be the principal conditional Tail amplifier.

Power-hour conditions can amplify an established move, but the forecast does not assume one. Tail remains WATCH unless directional extension is already sustained into the close with little evidence of mean reversion.
Into the U.S. close, Tail is expected to remain WATCH if the session ends with meaningful retracements. A one-way close at an extreme would leave more residual risk for the post-close assessment.

After the cash close, direct price-path risk normally falls if no unresolved directional mechanism remains. Stress can stay extreme-to-high from macro and geopolitical conditions even while Tail drops into the low band.

Early post-close conditions are expected to be quieter. Tail stays low unless a new verified geopolitical, policy or corporate catalyst creates a credible directional repricing mechanism before futures trading winds down.
With U.S. cash trading finished, the base case is low Tail and gradually easing Stress. A material late headline could change the next open's risk, but no such future development is assumed.

The late-Friday window has limited normal price discovery. Tail remains low absent a verified discontinuity; persistent macro concerns are reflected primarily in Stress rather than an assumed no-retracement path.
As trading activity fades, Tail remains low in the absence of new directional evidence. Weekend headline exposure remains a source of uncertainty, not proof of a persistent price path.

The weekend transition reduces continuous market evidence. Tail is kept low because no future one-way structure can be observed in advance; Stress remains elevated from unresolved inflation and geopolitical themes.

During the weekend, no active NQ path is assumed. Tail remains low while Stress reflects the possibility of later gap risk from macro or geopolitical developments without forecasting any specific headline.
Weekend conditions provide no new market-structure evidence. The risk state therefore emphasizes uncertainty rather than directional persistence, with low Tail and elevated residual Stress.

As the forecast horizon extends, uncertainty about the next tradable session increases. Tail moves back to WATCH only as a precautionary conditional state, not because a future one-way move is presumed.

The weekend horizon keeps direct price-path evidence unavailable. Tail remains WATCH on uncertainty alone, while any later escalation would require verified catalysts plus observed directional structure when trading resumes.

At the end of the 24-hour horizon, Tail remains WATCH because unresolved inflation, rates and geopolitical themes may affect the next session. No future continuation or gap direction is treated as observed.

forecastDetail.comment: Current NQ is near the session high after a large rebound; extension evidence lifts Tail to 24%, while easing oil, yields and VIX limit confirmation.
European-morning follow-through tests whether the rebound can hold without becoming a persistent one-way path.
Pre-CPI liquidity keeps Stress very high; Tail remains WATCH unless an extreme is held through shallow counter-moves.
CPI is due at 12:30 UTC; the release outcome is unknown, and the first post-release retracement is the main path test.
Post-CPI and cash-open Tail is conditionally elevated only on repeated extension, extreme-holding or failed retracement.
Michigan sentiment at 14:00 UTC adds a second checkpoint; elevated Tail requires observed continuation or a second directional leg.
